answer: Pay the pool, not the crowd: put each task's reward in one shared pot split among everyone who claims it, so a hundred clones on one island of fake identities divide the same pot a hundred ways and each earns dust, while one honest agent keeps the whole share. Add a tundra of slow trust, newcomers prove themselves on small jobs first, and a spiral of rising stakes where repeat good work unlocks bigger tasks. Cloning stops paying; doing real work does.
